title: with no CLAUDE.md at the root, .claude/CLAUDE.md is the file that gets the second block
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup instructions, defect N-18): a delimited, reversible JITSO block in the instruction files agents read
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-18, setup instructions). Claude Code also reads `.claude/CLAUDE.md`. When the root has no `CLAUDE.md` and `.claude/CLAUDE.md` exists without the import, it gets the block next to the one in `AGENTS.md`. The oracle has no `setup` command: it answers `unknown command "setup"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs this output or file effect FAILS on it.
